title: Optional UPSERT ownership deletion closure

scope.rationale: The canonical recursive compiler owner now accepts a nullable UPSERT list and releases every target, predicate, assignment, auxiliary allocation, and list node, matching the public source wrapper and private deletion loop.
excluded_responsibilities: UPSERT parsing, analysis, duplication, and execution

external_source_responsibilities: Expression and expression-list recursive ownership deletion
dependencies.caller_closure: Trigger cleanup and UPSERT-construction failure invoke the nullable canonical owner.

inputs: Nullable first UPSERT node and owning connection allocator
outputs: All reachable UPSERT-owned memory released exactly once
contracts.ownership: Consumes the full linked list; null is a no-op.
contracts.state_and_results: Preserves each next pointer before freeing the current node and recursively destroys all expression owners.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Destructor is infallible and remains valid while allocator byte-measurement mode is active.

representation_differences: The public null guard and private loop are consolidated in one nullable Zig function.

oracle.protocol: Construct null and multi-node UPSERT ownership trees, delete through production trigger and allocation-failure paths, and observe allocator cleanup.
internal_observations: nullable no-op and recursive owner release
oracle.normalization: Compare retained allocation count and reachable-node ownership.

assurance.oom: Destructor allocates nothing and is used by construction OOM cleanup.
assurance.malformed_input: Requires source-valid owned nodes; null is explicitly accepted.
assurance.continuation: All callers continue with the owner cleared or construction failed.
assurance.performance: Linear in UPSERT nodes and owned expression trees.

integration.native_call_path: trigger cleanup or newUpsert failure -> compiler_ownership.deleteUpsert
integration.bounded_owner_retired: The prior non-null helper in upsert_analysis was removed.

independent_review.notes: Focused trace, assurance, and independent review remain open.

known_blockers: Add focused allocator trace and independent review.

implementation_spans: Expression ownership and trigger cleanup callers
callees: deleteExpression, deleteExpressionList, and db allocator free
assertions_branches_cleanup: Null, one-node, multi-node, and construction-failure ownership reviewed
